summary: SBIN Depth at 20, 30 and 50 levels: refused with the web's words and its partial reply, nothing subscribed at Tradejini.

notes: The web's adapter refuses any depth but 5 in Depth mode before it looks the symbol up (tradejini_adapter.py:462-465, INVALID_DEPTH), ahead of its capability registry's fallback; the proxy then answers status partial with the item's message. web.json has no pushes: the reply is the case's check.
